description: Goa, the enchanting coastal state of India, known for its pristine beaches and vibrant nightlife, is also home to some of the most exciting water parks in the country. One such gem is the Blue Whale Water Park, nestled in the charming village of Arpora, North Goa. Boasting natural beauty at its best, this water park offers an oasis of fun and excitement, away from the hustle and bustle of hectic city life. LOCATION AND OPENING HOURS: The Blue Whale Water Park is strategically located in Arpora, North Goa, making it easily accessible from popular North Goa beaches like Baga and Calangute. The park opens its gates at 9:00 AM and welcomes visitors until 7:00 PM, providing five hours of exhilarating aquatic adventures. THE THRILLING AQUATIC ADVENTURE: As you step into the Blue Whale Water Park, you'll be captivated by the lush green surroundings and the picturesque landscapes that surround this delightful oasis. The park is thoughtfully designed to cater to visitors of all age groups, making it a perfect destination for families, friends, and even solo travelers seeking some aquatic fun. HIGHLIGHTS OF THE PARK: 1. Slides and Blaster Boats: Get ready for an adrenaline-pumping adventure as you slide down beautifully designed slides that offer a perfect blend of excitement and thrill. The blaster boats take the fun to another level, letting you feel the rush of water as you ride the waves. 2. Swimming Pools: The Blue Whale Water Park features not just one but four sparkling swimming pools where you can take a relaxing dip and cool off from the Goan sun. 3. Booster Boats: For those seeking an extra dose of excitement, the booster boats are a must-try! Hold on tight as you're propelled through the water, creating unforgettable memories with every splash. 4. Coconut Farming: Embrace the essence of rural Goa with the unique experience of coconut farming. Immerse yourself in the local culture and learn about the significance of coconuts in Goan life. BLUE WHALE WATER PARK GOA PACKAGE: The Blue Whale Water Park Goa package includes access to all the thrilling rides and attractions, ensuring an action-packed day for everyone. From water slides to booster boats, the park promises non-stop fun and entertainment. GUIDELINES AND TIPS: 1. Suitable For: The water park is suitable for visitors of all age groups, making it an ideal destination for families, friends, and even solo travelers seeking some fun and relaxation. 2. How to Reach: Blue Whale Water Park Goa is conveniently located at a distance of about 41.4 km from Goa International Airport. Visitors can reach the park via public or private transportation. 3. Things to Carry: Don't forget to carry your camera to capture the joyous moments, along with an ID proof and an extra pair of clothes. Sunglasses, sunscreen, and a hat are recommended to protect yourself from the tropical sun. 4. Advisory: Swimming costumes and lockers are available on-site at an additional cost, making it convenient for visitors to change and store their belongings securely. Separate changing rooms are thoughtfully provided for males and females. 5. Cancellation Policy: Visitors should be aware of the cancellation policy, which states that cancellations made 30 days before the trip will incur a 50% cancellation fee. For cancellations within 0-30 days before the trip, 100% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. Same-day cancellations are non-refundable. So, if you are seeking a thrilling aquatic adventure amidst the serene beauty of Goa, head to the Blue Whale Water Park and create lasting memories with your loved ones. This unique water park promises an unforgettable experience that will leave you longing for more. Come, dive into the excitement, and indulge in the joy of nature's bounty at the Blue Whale Water Park Goa! Experience the thrill, embrace the beauty, and make the most of your visit to this enchanting water park in Goa.

Valuables: Leave valuable items and jewelry at home or use the locker facilities provided by the water park to secure your belongings while enjoying the rides.
Hydration: Stay hydrated throughout your visit. Carry a refillable water bottle and drink plenty of water to avoid dehydration, especially during the hot summer months.
Follow Safety Rules: Pay attention to safety guidelines provided by the water park staff and adhere to all rules and regulations. Children should always be supervised by adults while using water attractions.
Food and Beverages: Many water parks have food and beverage options available on-site. However, if you prefer to bring your food, check with the park's policies on outside food and drinks.
Cash and Card: Carry sufficient cash or cards for any additional expenses, such as locker rentals, food, or merchandise.

all_paragraphs: Boasting to have natural beauty at its best, Goa is home to lush green forests, clean water beaches and few white sand beaches. There are various water parks in Goa among which Blue Whale Water Park Goa is one of the best in Goa. It is easily accessible from the North Goa beaches like Baga and Calangute. The waterpark is known for its exciting and thrilling slides specially designed for the kids. It is a major attraction for all those looking to beat the hot summer heat of the Goan land.
